description:
"From now on, with me, why don't you live with me?"  
Il-eon, who always being abused while being a slave, ate poisonous food but to found he woke up in Yang-myeong's body, the only survivor and Vice-president of a robber's clan who has completely disappears. But seeing how Yang Myeong seems unfamiliar with himself, making Foreign Geumgeum Inspector, Seonghwi feels more concern about him days by days.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Peanutoon](https://www.peanutoon.com/ko/comic/detail/5305), [Bomtoon](https://bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/Hwan_Jang), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/hwanjangrok), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/4451001925), [Comico](https://www.comico.kr/comic/8676), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=8955623), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000054223), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=220609)
